historical_record.description: The Recreation Commission engaged William G. Merchant, architect, to design a recreation clubhouse on Bay View Playground at Third and Armstrong Streets, on an estimated cost of $60,000.
The Recreation and Park Commission approved the final plans by Lee and Roberson, architects, for the bathhouse of the swimming pool at Bay View Playground.
The summer swimming pool at Bay View Playground was to open on August 3 and be formally dedicated that day by the Mayor, as announced to the Recreation and Park Commission.
